newsitem.title: USA: PS Colo. 262 MW power unit seen up next week.
newsitem.headline: PS Colo. 262 MW power unit seen up next week.

text.p: Public Service Co of Colorado's 262 megawatt (MW) coal-fired unit 2 at the Hayden power station will restart sometime next week, sources familiar with the plant's operation said Friday.

They said the unit, located near Steamboat Springs, Colo., has been shut for maintenance, but details on the cause of the outage were lacking and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Hayden's unit 1 was said to be operating operating at a rate of 180 MW.
